title: Vue Developer
description: Master the progressive Vue 3 framework, Composition API, Pinia state management, Vite build tooling, and Nuxt 3 fullstack SSR.

goal.objective: Build approachable, maintainable, and high-performance modern web apps using Vue 3, the Composition API, and the Nuxt ecosystem.

learn.summary: Deep dive into Vue 3 core reactivity (ref, reactive, computed), script setup syntax, component design, Pinia, Vue Router, and full-stack Nuxt 3 development.

capstone_projects.title: Modern High-Traffic E-Commerce Storefront with Nuxt 3 & SSR
capstone_projects.description: Develop a server-side rendered e-commerce catalog featuring faceted filtering, optimistic cart management via Pinia, SEO metadata optimization, and Stripe checkout.

capstone_projects.title: Enterprise Real-Time Project Management Board with Pinia & WebSockets
capstone_projects.description: Build a responsive kanban workspace featuring optimistic drag-and-drop card reordering, live multi-user cursor tracking, and comprehensive Vitest component coverage.

interview_focus: Vue 3 Reactivity System Internals (Proxy vs Object.defineProperty, ref vs reactive, shallowRef)
Composition API vs Options API & Custom Composables Architecture
Nuxt 3 Architecture (Nitro Server Engine, Auto-Imports, useAsyncData vs useFetch, Hydration)
State Management with Pinia (Stores, Getters, Actions, SSR Hydration & Plugins)
Performance Optimization in Vue 3 (v-once, v-memo, Virtual Scrolling, Component Lazy Loading)

tree.name: Foundations of Web & Vue
tree.description: Establish an unshakeable modern Vue 3 foundation: master the Composition API, Proxy-based reactivity engine, Vite build toolchain, and modern TypeScript architecture.

children.name: Web Development Fundamentals
children.description: Master web platform fundamentals for Vue: ES2024 JavaScript semantics (destructuring, async/await, modules), CSS Grid and modern CSS nesting, browser DOM event lifecycles, and network request pipelines.

resources.title: JavaScript Course for Beginners – Your First Step to Web Development (Programming with Mosh)

children.name: Introduction to Vue.js
children.description: Understand the Vue 3 architecture: declarative template rendering, the virtual DOM with compiler optimizations (hoisted static vnodes, patch flags for dynamic text/attributes), and comparing Vue's reactivity with React and Angular.

resources.title: Nuxt 3 Crash Course #1 - What is Nuxt? (Net Ninja)

children.name: Setting Up Your Vue Development Environment
children.description: Configure an enterprise Vue development workspace: Vite with `@vitejs/plugin-vue`, Volar language server in VS Code, ESLint with `plugin:vue/vue3-recommended`, Prettier, and TypeScript configuration.

tree.name: Core Vue.js Development
tree.description: Master core Vue 3 application development: template directives, reactive state primitives, `<script setup>` syntax, Pinia state stores, and Vue Router navigation.

children.name: Basic Directives & Event Handling
children.description: Master template directives and event handling: conditional rendering (`v-if` vs `v-show` layout costs), list rendering (`v-for` with mandatory unique keys), two-way data binding with `v-model` and component arguments (`v-model:title`), and event modifiers (`.prevent`, `.stop`, `.passive`, `.once`).

children.name: Computed Properties & Watchers
children.description: Master reactive derivations and side-effects: cached `computed` properties (getter/setter syntax), `watch` (watching specific sources, deep observation, immediate execution), `watchEffect` for automatic dependency tracking, and flush timing (`flush: 'post'` for DOM updates).

resources.title: Nuxt 3 Crash Course #1 - What is Nuxt? (Net Ninja)

children.name: Components & Reactivity Fundamentals
children.description: Deep dive into the Vue 3 Reactivity Engine: Proxy-based state tracking (`reactive` for objects vs `ref` for primitives), retaining reactivity with `toRefs` / `toRef`, avoiding reactivity loss during destructuring, and optimizing large data structures with `shallowRef`.

children.name: Vue Devtools & Debugging
children.description: Debug Vue applications with Vue DevTools: inspecting reactive component trees, tracking Pinia store state mutations with time-travel debugging, recording performance events, and routing timeline diagnostics.

children.name: Composition API vs. Options API
children.description: Master modern `<script setup>` and Composition API: compiler macros (`defineProps`, `defineEmits`, `defineModel` for seamless two-way binding, `defineExpose`), component lifecycle hooks (`onMounted`, `onUpdated`, `onUnmounted`, `onActivated`), and migrating legacy Options API codebases.

children.name: Routing with Vue Router
children.description: Master client-side routing with Vue Router 4: dynamic route parameters, nested routes, programmatic navigation, global and per-route navigation guards (`beforeEach`, `beforeEnter` for auth redirects), scroll behavior customization, and route meta fields.

resources.title: Nuxt 3 Crash Course #1 - What is Nuxt? (Net Ninja)

children.name: State Management with Pinia
children.description: Master centralized state management with Pinia: defining modular stores using Setup Store syntax (`defineStore` with refs and functions), computed getters, asynchronous actions, store subscriptions (`$subscribe`, `$onAction`), and plugin architecture for state persistence.

children.name: Forms and User Input Handling
children.description: Engineer robust form management: complex multi-step forms, schema validation with VeeValidate and Zod, managing input states (dirty, touched, valid), and building custom accessible form control components.

children.name: Working with APIs (HTTP Requests)
children.description: Master asynchronous data communication: building resilient API layers with Fetch and Axios interceptors (automatic token attachment, error handling, cancellation tokens with `AbortController`), and managing asynchronous loading and error UI states.

children.name: Styling Vue Applications
children.description: Master component styling: scoped CSS (`<style scoped>`), deep selectors (`:deep()`), slotted selectors (`:slotted()`), CSS Modules, dynamic CSS variables via `v-bind()` in styles, and modern utility-first styling with Tailwind CSS.

resources.title: Nuxt 3 Crash Course #1 - What is Nuxt? (Net Ninja)

children.name: Advanced Component Architecture & Features
children.description: Master advanced component patterns: custom Composables, dependency injection, type-safe generic components, and micro-animations.

children.name: Custom Directives & Plugins
children.description: Extend Vue core capabilities: authoring custom directives (`mounted`, `updated` hooks for click-outside detection and tooltip positioning), and creating modular Vue Plugins providing global properties, components, or injection keys.

children.name: Provide/Inject & Application Context
children.description: Master dependency injection across deep component hierarchies: `provide` and `inject` with TypeScript `InjectionKey<T>` symbols for strict compile-time type safety, providing read-only reactive states, and isolating component contexts.

children.name: TypeScript with Vue.js
children.description: Master TypeScript integration in Vue 3: typing props and emits with pure type syntax (`defineProps<{ id: string }>()`), generic components with `<script setup generic='T'>`, typing template refs, and strict type verification with `vue-tsc`.

resources.title: Nuxt 3 Crash Course #1 - What is Nuxt? (Net Ninja)

children.name: Custom Composables for Reusability
children.description: Architect clean, reusable logic with Composables: adhering to convention (`use*` naming), returning reactive objects with `ref`/`computed`, managing lifecycle subscriptions automatically, handling reactive parameters with `toValue()`, and authoring utility collections.

resources.title: Build Your Own Vue Composables (Vue Mastery)

children.name: Animations & Transitions
children.description: Build fluid micro-interactions and page transitions: `<Transition>` and `<TransitionGroup>` with CSS transition classes, JavaScript animation hooks with GSAP, interactive FLIP animations for reordered lists, and reduced-motion compliance.

children.name: UI Component Libraries & Design Systems
children.description: Integrate and customize enterprise UI component libraries: PrimeVue, Vuetify 3, or headless component primitives with Radix Vue, customizing design tokens and maintaining accessibility compliance.

resources.title: What is a Design System? (Adobe XD)

tree.name: Quality Assurance & Testing
tree.description: Implement enterprise testing and accessibility: unit testing, component harness tests, end-to-end automation, and WCAG compliance.

resources.title: Nuxt 3 Crash Course #1 - What is Nuxt? (Net Ninja)

children.name: Unit Testing with Vitest & Vue Test Utils
children.description: Master unit testing with Vitest and `@vue/test-utils`: mounting components (`mount`, `shallowMount`), triggering DOM events, asserting emitted events, mocking external composables and Pinia stores, and testing reactive business logic in isolation.

resources.title: Testing Vue 3 with Vitest and Vue Test Utils (Dev.to)

children.name: Integration Testing
children.description: Perform integration testing across component workflows: simulating real user input sequences, testing routing transitions, and mocking HTTP network calls with Mock Service Worker (MSW).

resources.title: Integration Testing for Vue.js (Vue Test Utils)

children.name: End-to-End (E2E) Testing
children.description: Automate end-to-end user journeys with Playwright: cross-browser test automation, visual regression testing, testing authentication flows, and integrating E2E runs into CI pipelines.

children.name: Code Quality, Linting & Formatting
children.description: Enforce automated repository standards: ESLint flat configurations, Prettier formatting, Git pre-commit hooks with Husky, and automated dependency vulnerability scans.

resources.title: Nuxt 3 Crash Course #1 - What is Nuxt? (Net Ninja)

children.name: Accessibility (A11y) in Vue
children.description: Ensure web accessibility (a11y): semantic HTML structure, ARIA roles and live regions, full keyboard navigation, managing focus trapped modals with `<Teleport>`, and running automated axe-core audits.

tree.name: Production Readiness & Operations
tree.description: Deploy, optimize, and scale production Vue and Nuxt 3 applications: build optimization, SSR, error telemetry, and CI/CD.

children.name: Building and Deployment Strategies
children.description: Optimize production bundles with Vite: dynamic code splitting, manual chunk splitting (`rollupOptions`), tree-shaking, asset compression (Gzip/Brotli), and deploying static builds to CDN edges.

children.name: Performance Optimization
children.description: Eliminate web performance bottlenecks: virtualized lists for large datasets, caching component trees with `<KeepAlive>`, moving heavy DOM elements with `<Teleport>`, asynchronous components with `defineAsyncComponent`, and Core Web Vitals optimization.

resources.title: Nuxt 3 Crash Course #1 - What is Nuxt? (Net Ninja)

children.name: Security Best Practices for SPAs
children.description: Harden frontend security: preventing XSS attacks by sanitizing untrusted HTML with DOMPurify, mitigating CSRF, configuring Content Security Policy (CSP) headers, and avoiding unsafe template expressions.

resources.title: OWASP Top 10 Web Application Security Risks

children.name: Monitoring and Error Handling
children.description: Implement production monitoring: centralized error capturing with `app.config.errorHandler`, integrating Sentry for real-time error tracking and source-map symbolication, and capturing user session replays.

children.name: Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD)
children.description: Build enterprise CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions: automated linting, running Vitest and Playwright test suites, building multi-stage Docker containers with NGINX, and automated preview deployments.

children.name: Server-Side Rendering (SSR) & Static Site Generation (SSG) with Nuxt
children.description: Master Server-Side Rendering and Full-Stack apps with Nuxt 3: Nitro server engine, server routes and API middleware (`/server/api`), auto-imports, asynchronous data fetching with `useAsyncData` and `useFetch`, SEO meta management with `useSeoMeta`, and hybrid rendering.

resources.title: Nuxt 3 Crash Course #1 - What is Nuxt? (Net Ninja)

tree.name: Portfolio & Career Advancement
tree.description: Demonstrate Vue 3 engineering mastery: build full-stack portfolio applications, author technical blog posts, and excel in senior Vue/Nuxt technical interviews.

children.name: Building a Strong Vue Portfolio
children.description: Curate a compelling engineering portfolio: documenting real-world applications with detailed architecture explanations, providing live demo links, and demonstrating modular Composable architecture.

resources.title: How to Create a Portfolio that Gets You Hired (Vue Mastery)

children.name: Interview Preparation for Vue Developers
children.description: Excel in technical frontend interviews: deep explanations of Vue 3 Proxy reactivity vs Vue 2 Object.defineProperty, live coding accessible UI components with `<script setup>`, and whiteboarding Nuxt 3 full-stack architectures.

children.name: Networking & Community Engagement
children.description: Engage with the global Vue ecosystem: contributing to open-source Vue libraries, participating in Vue community discussions, and attending developer conferences.

resources.title: Nuxt 3 Crash Course #1 - What is Nuxt? (Net Ninja)

children.name: Project: Advanced Vue Application Capstone
children.description: Capstone Project: Architect and Deploy a Production-Grade Full-Stack SaaS Application in Nuxt 3 & Vue 3: Nitro backend API routes, Pinia state stores with persistence, Composition API with custom composables, Tailwind CSS styling, authentication with HTTP-only cookies, full Vitest & Playwright test coverage, and containerized Docker deployment.

resources.title: Planning and Tracking a Project (GitHub Projects)
